title: Sliding Window Maximum
prompt: Given an integer array `nums` and a window size `k`, return the maximum value in each contiguous window of size `k` as it slides from left to right across the array — analogous to a streaming max over a fixed-size attention/token window.
hints: Recomputing the max of each window from scratch is O(nk) — think about what state you can maintain incrementally.
A monotonic decreasing deque of indices works: pop smaller elements off the back before pushing a new one, since they can never be the max again.
Also pop from the front once the index at the front falls outside the current window.
